summary: Frontend-only verification of PDF receipt wiring. Customer (customer@test.com) order detail Download + Print buttons, wallet ledger Receipt links, and admin order detail Receipt/Print buttons all fetch a real PDF (HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, body starts with %PDF). Security verified: customer requesting two other customers' order receipts got 403 {'detail':'Not allowed'}; admin fetched a foreign customer's order receipt successfully (200 PDF); unauthenticated fetch returns 401; unknown wallet txn / return id return 404. Refund-receipt link could NOT be exercised in the UI because the returns collection is empty (0 documents, no refunded returns) - conditional render never mounts.

issues: Totals row is labelled 'Total paid' even for COD orders with payment_status=pending and for cancelled orders (e.g. FG260800051, FG260800049 show 'Payment: Cash on Delivery - Pending' but 'Total paid Rs.1,318.2'). Admin screen correctly says 'Total payable'. Pre-existing, not receipt-related, but inconsistent with the PDF which shows 'Amount Payable' + 'Pending'.

action_items: Optional: relabel 'Total paid' to 'Total payable' on customer order detail when payment_status != paid (consistency with PDF + admin UI).

Refund receipt UI link (data-testid=refund-receipt-<id>) remains unverified end-to-end in the browser - no return/refund records exist in DB. Seed or create a refunded return if UI verification is required.
critical_code_review_comments: receipts.py: helper _oid is defined after wallet_receipt uses it (works at runtime, module-level) - fine but move above for readability.
receipt.js getReceipt() has no try/catch: a 403/404/500 blob response will reject and surface only as an unhandled promise (no toast). Callers should catch and show an error toast.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable receipt flows (5/5); refund-receipt link untestable due to missing data

seed_data_creation: None - no destructive orders or returns created.
